newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Steel seen posting larger 6-mth loss - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Steel seen posting larger 6-mth loss - paper.

text.p: Tokyo Steel Manufacturing Co Ltd is expected to post a parent current loss of five billion yen in the six months to September 30, 1996, against a loss of 1.53 billion yen the same period a year ago, a Japanese economic daily said on Thursday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun newspaper said its estimate was due to lower-than-expected output at the company's new plant in Utsunomiya, near Tokyo. The paper reported that the company said earlier this year that it would post a half-year parent current loss of two billion yen. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
